summary: Prairie Operating Co. filed an 8-K on August 31, 2026 reporting an August 30, 2026 letter agreement with Hudson Bay PH XIX LLC (High Trail) amending its March 24, 2025 Securities Purchase Agreement. The Anniversary Warrant Issuance Date shifts from August 31, 2026 to December 1, 2026, and a warrant for 3,000,000 common shares at $0.01 per share (Second Penny Warrant) is likewise extended. The modification touches holder rights under the Series F Convertible Preferred Stock. Watch for potential dilution upon warrant issuance and any further amendments or forbearance tied to the Series F financing.
